figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, wealthy like Kubera (the god of wealth)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাছে একটা টাকাও নেই, তবু বন্ধুরা তাকে ধনেশ্বর বলে ডাকে।
এই ধনেশ্বরের মতো খরচ করলে তো দেউলিয়া হয়ে যাবি।
example_sentences_in_english: He doesn't have a single penny, yet his friends sarcastically call him Dhaneeshwar.
Spending like this Dhaneeshwar will make you bankrupt.
history: References Kubera, the Hindu god of wealth from ancient mythology, often used in Bengali folklore to denote ironic richness.
note: This idiom draws from Hindu mythology where Kubera is the treasurer of gods, implying mock opulence.
